# Drawer
Atlas Drawer v1 — an edge-anchored side panel: header (title + close), description, content and footer. When to use: a persistent side menu or a secondary panel that stays docked to the viewport edge (e.g. a mobile nav drawer). When not to use: a centered, momentary decision (use Dialog) or a bottom sheet on mobile (use Sheet). Do: keep the flush edge (against the viewport) flat and the free edge rounded. Don't: add a drag handle — Drawer has none, only Sheet does.
